Name: Android System Server Local Privilege Escalation (run-as bypass)
Description: The remote Android device is affected by a local privilege escalation vulnerability due to an input validation error in PackageInstallerService. An attacker could exploit this by installing a crafted package with a package.list injection to execute commands as any target UID.

Name: Android ExternalStorageProvider Logical File Access Bypass
Description: The remote Android device is affected by an access control bypass vulnerability in the ExternalStorageProvider. A local app could exploit this via lack of NFKC normalization to bypass restrictions on private files.

Name: Android PermissionController Privilege Bypass
Description: The remote Android device is affected by a privilege bypass vulnerability in PermissionController during HealthFitness IPC communication. A local app could exploit this to bypass user consent prompts.
